title.zh: Mercury 3挑战GPT-6 Luna：比初代大40倍，官方测速仍超千Token/秒
title.en: Mercury 3挑战GPT-6 Luna：比初代大40倍，官方测速仍超千Token/秒

current_state.zh: Inception released Mercury 3, a diffusion language model with over 40x the parameters of the original and 1M-token context that the company claims matches or beats GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on aggregate benchmarks at 4-8x their generation speed, now available through Inception API, OpenRouter, Baseten and Vercel at discounted launch pricing.
